description: This file provides functions for transforming OpenTelemetry attribute data into OTLP key-value format, including handling various attribute types and slices.

methods.name: KeyValues
methods.description: Transforms a slice of attribute KeyValues into OTLP key-values.

methods.name: Iterator
methods.description: Transforms an attribute iterator into OTLP key-values.

methods.name: ResourceAttributes
methods.description: Transforms a Resource into OTLP key-values.

methods.name: KeyValue
methods.description: Transforms an attribute KeyValue into an OTLP key-value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Transforms an attribute Value into an OTLP AnyValue.

methods.name: boolSliceValues
methods.description: Converts a slice of bools into a slice of OTLP AnyValues.

methods.name: int64SliceValues
methods.description: Converts a slice of int64s into a slice of OTLP AnyValues.

methods.name: float64SliceValues
methods.description: Converts a slice of float64s into a slice of OTLP AnyValues.

methods.name: stringSliceValues
methods.description: Converts a slice of strings into a slice of OTLP AnyValues.
